title: :emoji: A Very MetaFilter Christmas, No Assembly Or Batteries Required!
content:
Hello and Merry Soon To be Christmas! We're sharing links to recent posts related to the holiday, so let's get into it:

First up is the The Metafilter Christmas MST3K/Rifftrax marathon, back for its 12th year of low-stress, slightly chaotic, tv watching from Dec 23–25 .
Shared by MeFi's MST3K ambassador,  JHarris

Second is a post looking back at the 1987 A Muppets Family Christmas TV special, featuring 45 minutes off all the goodness that Muppets bring.
Shared by Dawn Trask-Dontell.

Thirdly is a round-up of Christmas jumpers from UK museums and heritage shops, and yes, it's as delightful as it sounds!
Merrily shared by paduasoy

Fourthly is a collection of Christmas stories about how things went wrong during the holiday. This one is for those who eyes roll during the season (or at least at family dinner). Christmas isn't always great for everyone, but it does produce interesting situations!
Wordshore shared this!

Next up (tired of counting) is a post about Bob Dylan's Christmas lights from 2008-2018. That description alone should be enough to entice you.  
Brighly Shared by Shooboo (blink tag, we miss you!)

Meanwhile, over in AskMetafilter, there are several Christmas related questions, including:

  • whether one should skip the family gathering
  • a request for tasteless Christmas music
  • Suggestions for awesome, or cute, or unusual holiday ornaments (yes, it's a bit late for that now, but it's still fun)
  • Seeking snack suggestions for Christmas list (also late, but then again, it's never too late for snacks)
  • Recommendations on what to put in small bags of supplies for homeless people
author: Brandon Blatcher
